# Talking Precision Medicine: Meeting Clinicians and Patients Where They Are


09 Apr 2026


In a recent *Talking Precision Medicine* podcast episode, Labcorp’s VP of Oncology, Dr. Shakti Ramkissoon, shared insights from the **2026** ***Pulse of the Oncologist*** **report** , reflecting on access, workflow friction, and the importance of delivering clarity — not complexity — in care.


Listen to the full episode[here](https://www.genialis.com/2026/04/09/the-pulse-of-the-oncologist-meeting-clinicians-and-patients-where-they-are-to-deliver-precision-medicine-tpm-podcast-55/) .
